title: AR-VLA: True Autoregressive Action Expert for Vision-Language-Action Models

tldr.en: Replace resetting action chunks with a persistent autoregressive expert conditioned on refreshable vision-language prefixes and re-anchor stale perception.
tldr.zh: 以保留长期历史的自回归动作专家替换反复重置的动作块，接受可刷新的视觉语言前缀，并重锚定过时感知。

evaluation_scope.en: Simulation and real-robot experiments with specialist and generalist policies; requires training an autoregressive action expert.
evaluation_scope.zh: 专用/通用策略的仿真与真机实验，需要训练自回归动作专家。
